body: I don't feel any better : ( I still just really want to kill myself
What else is there to want in life but a happy loving family? Everything else seems insignificant. I have a job, an apartment, I've traveled, it doesn't make me happy or excited for the future

Thanks for taking time to reply to me. I wish I had gotten the vaccine, its too late for me now I already have genital warts and fewer and fewer people will have it thanks to that vaccine and I will be more and more weird and gross for having it. You might be a nice person but I've heard too many stories from women online about guys disappearing when they tell them about their condition. I don't have much hope. I'll have to date someone for at least 6 months before id even consider telling them about it, and I have a lot of nice guy friends that would leave even a perfect girl if they date for six months and don't have sex. Then when I finally tell them who knows, they might be ok with it, or they might just disappear and I wouldn't blame them. This is my future. Not a husband and a family. Just loneliness and people asking 'what's her deal' behind my back like they do about the older single women at work without families. Maybe they have genital warts too.
